summary:
The 14 design criteria hold where they could be reached. Some were checked against real data and real environments, the rest through the suite. But the slice reached validation with eight fix obligations from the code review still open in the tree (O-043 to O-050). There has been no build attempt since the review, none of their repro test files exist, and HEAD is still da3d80f. I measured two of them myself: O-049 (other spellings of C:\ are misclassified) and O-050 (the lister returns 0 files for a root written with '/' or ending '\.'). The other six I confirmed by reading the lines in question. All eight are owed to build-slice, so the verdict is partial, not passes.

What ran:
- **Full suite:** 1249/1249.
- **Fitness:** every rule holds; the proof-run record rule is waiting for its file.
- **W-001 -Stopped on this PC's real C:\ProgramData:** held. The finished run had 4,167 folders and 482 code-5 rows; the store was not scanned. The stopped run stopped at 3,379 folders with sized '-' and had 478 rows, all matched.
- **W-001 -Stopped on the real AppData:** held. The finished run had 509,847 folders and 30 rows; the stopped run stopped at 255,497 folders with 29 rows, all matched.
- **SUBST finish-line script:** held. The record was written at docs/proof-runs, the coverage figures were recorded, and nothing was written under .taad.

In Windows Sandbox, as a new standard user (Medium IL):
- **W-002 on the CfProvider rig** passed for the first time: 5 files online-only before and after, 0 hydrated, 0 fetches.
- **W-003 on the SMB stall rig** passed for the first time: 6,127 ms from Stop to the stopped ending, no cut-short row.
- **W-001 -Root C:\ -Stopped on the Sandbox's whole C:\:**
  - It wrote docs/proof-runs/w001-c-drive.json with no path in it, and the record guard stayed quiet over it.
  - The stopped part held: 82 of 84 rows, partial.
  - The finished part FAILED, correctly: the report's coverage was null and the panel was hidden. That comes from CoveragePanelText.Build, product code this slice did not change.
  - So the Sandbox's C:\ cannot stand in for this PC's coverage figures.

A first Sandbox attempt as SYSTEM failed for environment reasons, and the existing cases N-005 and N-006 failed the same way there.

Every real stopped/finished pair kept the code-5 subset, which discharges O-038 for everything reachable. Criteria C1b, C3, C5, C8 and C9 stay person-run.

criteria.criterion: 1. W-001 writes its whole-drive record where it is kept (whole SUBST drive letter over a %TEMP% tree with one folder this account may not list)
criteria.how: I reran SL-003-W001OnASubstDrive.Tests.ps1 on this PC: exit 0, record at docs/proof-runs/w001-x-drive.json, no path in it, nothing written under .taad, and everything removed afterwards. In the Sandbox, a whole-C:\ run wrote docs/proof-runs/w001-c-drive.json and the record guard stayed quiet over it. git grep for taad in WindowCases.ps1 prints nothing.

criteria.criterion: 2. W-001 requires and records the coverage panel's figures on a whole drive
criteria.how: Positive side: the SUBST run recorded volumeInUse 877,711,765,504, unseen, panelTop 113 and textsHeight 76, and held. Negative side, met for real: the Sandbox's whole C:\ ended with coverage null and the panel hidden, and W-001 FAILED, naming both gaps and writing verdict failed. That missing panel is product behaviour (CoveragePanelText.cs:80-82), not this slice's code.

criteria.criterion: 3. W-001 -Stopped compares a run stopped partway with the finished run
criteria.how:
Four real stopped runs, each with sized '-', compared against their finished runs and held:
- C:\ProgramData: 478/478 matched, stopped at 3,379 of 4,167 folders.
- AppData: 29/29, at 255,497 of 509,847.
- Sandbox whole C:\: 82/82, at 79,633 of 157,491.
- SUBST tree: stopped at 17,102.
No 995 row, and no code-5 row missing from the finished run.

criteria.criterion: 4. classify a stopped run's row against the finished tab (six classes)
criteria.how: W001ProofTests.AStoppedRowIsPutInOneOfTheSixClasses passed in the 1249/1249 suite. The real runs only ever produced Matched.

criteria.criterion: 5. decide whether a stopped run was partial, from the hook's acted line
criteria.how: TheActedLineIsReadInBothFormsAndPartialMeansStoppedWhileListing passed in the suite. On real progress-form lines ('atfolders=2083 folders=3379 sized=-' and three others), the case read folders= rather than atfolders= and judged each run partial.

criteria.criterion: 6. show that a row's code is the code of the call that failed (C4)
criteria.how: W001OracleTests corpus row F17 (folder held without read sharing, answers 32) passed in the suite. On real rows, refusedAnotherCode was 0 and every code-5 row was still refused: 482 on ProgramData, 2 on AppData, 81 on the Sandbox C:\.

criteria.criterion: 7. check that each row's reason belongs to its code
criteria.how: AReasonThatDoesNotBelongToItsCodeIsCounted passed. reasonCodeMismatches was 0 on all three real trees. On the Sandbox C:\ that check is required (local letter) and held, with the code-2 reason '... (Windows error 2)'.

criteria.criterion: 8. write a record after an expensive run (995 reason with a slash; coverage holding remainder.text)
criteria.how: EveryStringACaseWouldPutInARecordIsWritten and ACoverageRecordHoldsNoStringAndIsWritten passed in the suite. No real 995 row occurred to exercise it.

criteria.criterion: 9. label a record, and keep proof cases out of All
criteria.how: EveryNetworkAndLinkValueIsAcceptedByTheWriter and ProofCasesAreNeverRunByCaseAll passed in the suite.

criteria.criterion: 10. classify W-001's root ('C:\', 'C:', a network letter, a UNC share root, a folder)
criteria.how: For the inputs this criterion names: RootsAreClassedAndKeptWhereTheirShapeSays passed, and I measured 'C:\' -> local-letter, R\docs\proof-runs\w001-c-drive.json. Other spellings of the same drive are misclassified ('C:/' and 'C:\.' -> folder, '\\?\C:\' -> unc). That is open obligation O-049, owed to build-slice.

criteria.criterion: 11. prove a scan hydrates no online-only file (CfProvider 'tree' rig)
criteria.how: Windows Sandbox, standard user, SL-003-W002OnTheCloudRig.Tests.ps1: exit 0. 5 files online-only before and 5 after, 0 hydrated, 0 FETCH_DATA from the app's pid, the root unregistered and its folder gone, record verdict held with no path.

criteria.criterion: 12. tally hydration (still online-only, hydrated, gone, none online-only)
criteria.how: AScanIsJudgedAgainstTheOnlineOnlyFilesBeforeAndAfter passed in the suite. The Sandbox rig run exercised 'still online-only' for real.

criteria.criterion: 13. time Stop to a usable window on a share that stopped answering, and keep the cut folder out (stall rig)
criteria.how: Windows Sandbox, standard user, SL-003-W003OnTheStallRig.Tests.ps1: exit 0. Cancelled; Stop to the stopped ending 6,127 ms on the hook's one clock; rows a(5) and b(59) only; no row for s, t, u or code 995; no mapping left.

criteria.criterion: 14. guard committed records against paths at their new place
criteria.how: Fitness op=check: the moved rule holds and waits for docs/proof-runs/*.json. In the Sandbox, SL-107-RecordPathRule.Tests.ps1 fired on every corpus row (D, U, R and V families), stayed quiet on every Q row, and stayed quiet over a real whole-drive record at docs/proof-runs/w001-c-drive.json. The harness plant rows S91-S94 and P41 themselves were not rerun by me (no Python with yaml).

criteria.criterion: C1b: W-001 has actually been run on this PC's real C:\, non-elevated, finished Completed, coverage panel shown
criteria.how: The maintainer, in an ordinary (non-elevated) pwsh on this PC, runs: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case W-001 -Root C:\ -Stopped. Ideally after build-slice fixes O-044, O-045, O-047 and O-049. It must print 'PASSED: W-001' and write docs/proof-runs/w001-c-drive.json with status Completed, outcome completed, coverage not null and verdict held. Two scans of C:\ can hold kernel pool until a restart: in the Sandbox, a 157k-folder C:\ grew paged pool by about 900 MB.

criteria.criterion: C3: this makes the record docs/design/SL-107-c-drive-run.md says is owed
criteria.how: The maintainer commits docs/proof-runs/w001-c-drive.json from the C1b run. After that, Fitness reports 'a committed proof-run record carries counts, codes and reasons, never a path' matching 1 file and holding, and pwsh -File tests/bugs/SL-107-RecordPathRule.Tests.ps1 prints 'All checks held'.

criteria.criterion: C5: a second C:\ run stopped partway: every folder in its Unreadable folders tab also appears in the finished run's tab, and none is a folder Stop cut short
C8: a case scans a real OneDrive sync root and compares its files' online-only state before and after (no hydration)
criteria.how: The maintainer, with OneDrive paused or idle, runs: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case W-002 -IncludeCloud -Root <their OneDrive folder, written with backslashes and no trailing '\.' (O-050)>. Then they check docs/proof-runs/w002-onedrive.json: source sync-root, onlineOnlyBefore > 0, hydrated 0, verdict held.

criteria.criterion: C9: a timed real-share case (home LAN and Tailscale): Stop to a usable window, the cut folder absent from the tab, counts-only record under docs/proof-runs
criteria.how:
The maintainer runs: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case W-003 -IncludeNetwork -Root <share> -Network home -Link wifi-off, then again with -Network tailscale -Link tunnel-down, and -Link server-asleep. Each time they make the cut and type 'cut' within 60 s of launch.
Each record docs/proof-runs/w003-<network>-<link>.json must show verdict held, stopToEndingMs > 0, cutFolderRows 0 and status Cancelled.
Until O-043 and O-046 are fixed, judge by the record's verdict, not the exit code. A Stop that reached no ending currently exits 0.

obligations.evidence:
Measured on every real finished/stopped pair I could reach. In each, no code-5 folder appeared in the stopped run that was not in the finished run, and none changed kind:
- C:\ProgramData: 478 of 478 matched.
- AppData, including 28 code-363 rows stable across the pair: 29 of 29.
- The Sandbox's whole Windows C:\: 82 of 82.
- The SUBST tree.
This adds to spike denied-set-gains-no-folders-in-30-min (549/549). Still unmeasured: OneDrive, the CrossDevice root and the person's own folders. There the maintainer's own -Stopped run tests the relation itself, and a breach shows as NotInFinished and fails, or OtherCodeDiffers and ends inconclusive. It never ends held.

Not fixed:
- tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/W003RealStopNoEndingReproTests.cs is absent, and no commit followed the review (HEAD da3d80f).
- WindowCases.ps1:7158 still makes $judged require $null -ne $scan.
- Get-ShareVerdict (7032-7037) returns 'inconclusive' at -not $judged before it reaches the TIMEOUT -> failed branch.
- Lines 7159-7160 call Inconclusive only when the answer is not 'cut' or there is no acted line. So when Stop is acted but there is no report, no Check runs and the case still exits 0.

Not fixed. Invoke-W001StoppedRun (WindowCases.ps1:6650-6663) still retries every attempt that is not partial, including Exit TIMEOUT and attempts with no report. Only the last attempt's Exit and Report are checked (6664-6665). W001StoppedTimeoutReproTests.cs is absent.
Same unfixed loop: WindowCases.ps1:6650-6663 has no break on an Exit other than '0' or on a null Report. W001StoppedRetryTests.cs is absent.
Not fixed. WindowCases.ps1:7152 still only Write-Outputs the missed-deadline line, with no Inconclusive() call. W003MarkerRefusedReproTests.cs is absent.

Not fixed. WindowCases.ps1:6852 is still 'if ($Stopped) { Invoke-W001StoppedRun ... }' with no core.status test. The CheckEqual 'Completed' at 6770 does not return. W001StoppedAfterIncompleteReproTests.cs is absent.
Not fixed. WindowCases.ps1:6979 still runs CheckEqual 'Completed' $scan.core.status, so a Refused scan fails where the record says inconclusive. W002NotCompletedReproTests.cs is absent.

Measured, by loading Get-W001RootShape and Get-ProofRecordPath from the script's parse:
- 'C:\' -> local-letter, R\docs\proof-runs\w001-c-drive.json.
- 'C:/' -> folder, R\artifacts\w001-run.json.
- 'C:\\' -> folder.
- 'C:\.' -> folder.
- '\\?\C:\' -> unc.
No corpus for the class exists, and W001RootSpellingTests.cs is absent.
Measured: [FsaWindowCases.Seam]::ListFiles on one temp tree printed 'listed plain=2 slashes=0 dot=0'. No corpus exists, and W002ListingRootSpellingTests.cs is absent.

not_reached: A whole C:\ of THIS PC, run non-elevated, finished and stopped (C1b, C3, C5). It is person-run, and it is the only run that answers Q-001 (unseen against the $MFT's 10,540,285,952 B) and Q-002 (where the panel sits on this screen).

Whether this PC's whole-C:\ ending actually shows the coverage panel. The Sandbox's whole C:\ ended with coverage null (unseen < 0, or no volume figure), so it cannot stand in. The SUBST runs over this PC's C: volume did get coverage.
A real OneDrive sync root (C8). Only the CfProvider rig was run, in the Sandbox.
A real share at home and over Tailscale with a physical cut (C9). W-003 real mode, with its prompts, the typed 'cut' and the 60 s marker, has never been run by anyone.
O-038 inside OneDrive, the CrossDevice (Phone Link) sync root and the person's own folders: they were not listed.

Kernel pool cost of the two whole-C:\ scans on this PC. In the Sandbox, a 157k-folder C:\ grew paged pool by about 900 MB and nonpaged by about 370 MB over the pair. This PC's C:\ is far larger, and the engine stops agents at 3 GB of kernel growth.
The rules-harness plant rows S91-S95, P41 and P42: I found no Python with yaml, so only the builder's run exists.
The engine's own repro runs for O-043 to O-050: those tests are not in the tree, because no build attempt followed the review.
The Sandbox tool left its own run folders untracked in the worktree under .taad-scratch/sandbox/ (run-20261118-020857, run-20261118-021221). They are engine-made, and I did not delete them.
